In a later control-plane-only round, invalidate A0 because its path ownership registry cannot express the required atomic persistence-authority migration.
Re-run A0 to assign the old persistence-authority files to A1 for retirement and assign A2 clean replacement implementation paths; preserve disjoint ownership and v4 isolation.
Re-run A1 to define the canonical persistent schemas in mode_p_vnext.domain and retire or convert every old executable semantic equivalent in the same work package.
Resume A2 only after A1 completes; implement storage behavior exclusively against A1 domain schemas in the clean A2 paths.
Run all registered checks, affected regressions, architecture authority scans, Evidence validation, ReleaseLedger audit, and Git verification at every package boundary.
